# Spark Control Center 1.4.1

## Workflow and audit usability

- Display tenant names and clear stale selection/polling when the last project is deleted.
- Improve workflow, schedule and execution-history spacing at desktop/laptop widths.
- Connect tasks by dragging border ports; support fan-in/fan-out, automatic edge directions, cycle rejection and synchronized upstream-task forms. Links can be selected and removed; keyboard connection is also available.
- Add operator, operation and result filters to Operation Audit. Long operation names no longer overlap results, and semantic colors distinguish actions.
- Ignore aborted login checks during React StrictMode remount, preserving the requested page.

## Second-level Cron and bounded previews

- Support six-field Cron (second first), retaining five-field compatibility at second 0.
- Add dropdown configuration for second/minute intervals and hourly/daily/weekly/monthly/yearly schedules, plus custom expressions.
- Preview up to ten future executions **inside the configured validity window**, returning only those that fit. Empty/invalid windows show an error; configuration changes clear stale results.
- Optimize `fire_once` after prolonged downtime instead of iterating over millions of second-level occurrences.

The dispatch scan defaults to 5 seconds. Set `workflows.scheduler.scanInterval: 1s` for finer scanning, and review concurrency/misfire policies before using frequent schedules. See the [workflow guide](https://github.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/blob/v1.4.1/docs/WORKFLOWS.md). No schema migration or schedule rewrite is required for this patch; back up PostgreSQL before upgrades.

Screenshots use deterministic test fixtures, not production data. Validation covers frontend tests/build, Go tests/vet with PostgreSQL, bounded-preview HTTP cases, production-container smoke tests with a Kubernetes HTTP fixture, Helm lint/template/package and English 1440/1024px browser regressions. Cluster-specific Spark operator/admission behavior still needs a non-production workflow check.

Image tags have no private registry prefix. Load the tar files with `docker load -i`, then push to your own registry if needed.
